invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2000（基于ATR 17.2345和支撑上移），或融资费率Z-score转正>50%（多头风险增加），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 $2039.71）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2000 (based on ATR 17.2345 and raised support), or funding Z-score turns positive >50% (long risk increases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $2039.71).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破82（基于ATR 0.805和支撑下移），或融资费率Z-score转负<-50%（空头风险缓解但多头拥挤仍存），或日线趋势转牛（价格突破SMA50 $85.80）但需谨慎。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 82 (based on ATR 0.805 and lowered support), or funding Z-score turns negative <-50% (short risk eases but long crowding remains), or daily trend turns bullish (price > SMA50 $85.80) but with caution.
